xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition: As on 31st December 2025, NTPC had six Functional Directors including the CMD, two Government Nominee Directors and 5 Independent Directors on the Board. Accordingly, the Company is short of 3 Independent Directors. NTPC is a Government Company under section 2(45) of the Companies Act, 2013. As per the Articles of Association of the Company, the power to appoint or remove the Directors vests with the President of India. We have accordingly, requested MoP to appoint requisite number of independent directors on the Board of NTPC so as to comply with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI LODR Regulations).
